name: Virgo Supercluster
tagline: The Local Supercluster — a flattened cloud of ~100 galaxy groups centred on the Virgo Cluster ~54 Mly away.

facts.label: Contains
facts.value: ~100 galaxy groups, Local Group at its edge

history: The Virgo Supercluster is the Local Group's address in the universe — a flattened congregation of roughly a hundred galaxy groups stretched across 110 million light-years, centred on the giant Virgo Cluster. The Local Group sits on its fringe, a small district orbiting a metropolis. Its pancake geometry defines the Supergalactic Plane, the surface on which most nearby structure is laid. The whole supercluster is itself only a filament feeding into the still larger Laniakea basin.
